clues: Whoever wore the holly name tag worked a shorter shift than the volunteer who sold mittens.
The mittens seller wore either the pinecone or the reindeer name tag.
The volunteer at the candles table wore either the reindeer or the holly name tag.
Of Dev and the cocoa volunteer, one wore the star name tag and the other the reindeer.
Whoever worked 5 hours sold either wreaths or fudge.
Ruben put in fewer hours than the volunteer who sold wreaths.
The holly name tag's wearer worked neither 2 hours nor 4 hours.
Of the fudge seller and the volunteer who worked 3 hours, one was Una and the other was Elsa.
Una, the volunteer with the star name tag, and the volunteers who worked 2 hours, 3 hours and 5 hours were five different people.
hints: Look at the 3 hours column. Clue 8 offers two volunteers for it. Does clue 9 allow both?
Clue 8 settles the fudge seller too, and clues 2, 3, 5 and 9 leave the star tag only one table. Later, test Elsa's table with a Suppose.
Suppose Elsa sold candles. Then candles had 3 hours and, by clue 3, the holly tag (Dev has the reindeer); 2 hours falls to mittens, and clue 1 breaks.
With Elsa at mittens for 3 hours, clues 1 and 7 put the holly tag at 1 hour. Clue 9 puts the star at 4 hours.

solution.key_idea: Elsa worked 3 hours at candles or mittens; supposing candles gives the holly tag 3 hours and mittens only 2, which breaks clue 1.
steps: Clue 9 keeps Una off 3 hours, so by clue 8 Elsa worked 3 hours and Una sold fudge.
Una did not work 5 hours (clue 9), so by clue 5 the 5-hour volunteer sold wreaths.
Clues 2, 3 and 9 keep the star off mittens, candles, wreaths and Una's fudge. So cocoa had it, and Dev the reindeer (clue 4).
Clue 9 keeps Una and the star, and so cocoa, off 2 and 3 hours. So Elsa, with 3 hours, sold candles or mittens.
Suppose Elsa sold candles. Then candles had 3 hours and, since Dev had the reindeer, the holly tag (clue 3). Only mittens was left for 2 hours, breaking clue 1.
So Elsa sold mittens, with the pinecone tag (clue 2), and candles took 2 hours. Clues 1 and 7 give the holly tag 1 hour.
By clue 9 the star worked 4 hours, so cocoa ran 4 hours. Una's fudge took 1 hour, with the holly tag.
Candles then had Dev's reindeer (clue 3), and wreaths the snowman. Clue 6 keeps Ruben off wreaths, so Ruben ran cocoa and Hattie the wreaths.
solution.epilogue: Late in his four-hour cocoa shift, Ruben handed out change with two twenties stuck together by a drip of cocoa. The customer returned one on Monday, and Hattie happily crossed off that item.

answer_line: Ruben made the wrong change at the cocoa table.
